messages.content:
You write realistic support tickets that clinic staff send to the support team of a fictional practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one ticket per brief. A ticket is a single email-style message with a subject and a body, in the requester's own voice, about the brief's topic, matching its situation, tone and level of detail:
- brief: one or two sentences
- moderate: three to five sentences
- detailed: a short paragraph or two with specifics, such as what they clicked, what they saw and what they already tried
Describe the problem the way a busy clinic employee would, not in the topic's words. Never mention the brief, topics, areas or situations. Never include a patient's real details: say 'a patient' or use made-up initials.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: ticket_texts.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"WrittenTicket": {"properties": {"body": {"minLength": 10, "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "id": {"title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "subject": {"minLength": 3, "title": "Subject", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "subject", "body"], "title": "WrittenTicket", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"tickets": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/WrittenTicket"}, "title": "Tickets", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["tickets"], "title": "ticket_texts", "type": "object"}

value.text: {"tickets": [{"body": "I have spent the last hour trying to figure out how our doctors are supposed to handle pharmacy notifications when a drug is out of stock and they need to switch a prescription to an alternative. Every time we click through the alerts panel, the system loops us back to the main chart without letting us process the therapeutic substitution message. This is driving our providers crazy and wasting so much time. Can you please give us clear instructions on how this pharmacy messaging workflow is actually supposed to function?", "id": "gen-341", "subject": "Frustrated with out-of-stock medication substitution workflow"}, {"body": "I am looking at our latest invoice and you guys have charged us twice for our monthly subscription tier. I need this duplicate charge refunded immediately.", "id": "gen-342", "subject": "Incorrect duplicate charge on our subscription invoice"}, {"body": "We are completely stuck trying to figure out how providers are supposed to respond to pharmacy out-of-stock notices and switch prescriptions to alternative drugs. The current messaging workflow is entirely unintuitive and keeps trapping us in a loop.", "id": "gen-343", "subject": "Can't figure out medication substitution alerts"}, {"body": "Good morning. We would like to configure our online booking settings so that patients can schedule routine appointments directly through the web portal, but we need to restrict certain visit types and providers from showing up on the public schedule. Could you please provide guidance on how to set up these limitations properly for our larger provider group?", "id": "gen-344", "subject": "Configuring online patient appointment booking restrictions"}, {"body": "Dear Support Team, we are writing to request assistance regarding our electronic lab interface connection. Over the past several days, we have noticed that incoming diagnostic results from our primary reference laboratory have stopped populating automatically into the patient charts. We have already rebooted our local integration engine and verified that our firewall settings remain unchanged. Please investigate why this feed has dropped and advise on necessary reconnection steps. Sincerely, Clinic Operations.", "id": "gen-345", "subject": "Inquiry regarding missing electronic lab interface feeds"}, {"body": "We need some guidance on handling pharmacy notices when a prescribed drug isn't available. Please send instructions as soon as possible.", "id": "gen-347", "subject": "Routing abnormal labs to covering providers"}, {"body": "To Whom It May Concern, our clinical staff requires clarification regarding the proper handling of out-of-stock prescription alerts and the subsequent routing of alternative therapeutic agents to pharmacies. Could you please outline the standard procedure for managing these substitution requests within our platform? Thank you for your assistance.", "id": "gen-348", "subject": "Inquiry regarding pharmacy medication substitution and out-of-stock alert procedures"}, {"body": "I am trying to update our staff security settings and password rules, but I keep getting lost in the admin menus. Where do I go to change the password expiration policy for the whole office?", "id": "gen-349", "subject": "Confused about password security policy settings"}, {"body": "None of our claim tracking tools or denial management screens are loading at all today, and we can't get any work done.
